A 3-step progress bar, a ticket-hold timer that
warns in the last two minutes and a live order
total tell users where they are and what is
Fees are shown before payment, ticket limits
are explained and a failed payment keeps the
order and offers clear next steps.
One colour accent, one card pattern, one
button hierarchy and the same header on every
Active filters show as removable pills, event
details repeat in the order summary and saved
Back links on every step, guest checkout, free
Every action answers back: inline field errors on
blur, toasts after saving or cancelling, loading
states on buttons and a live seat count.
Press / to search from anywhere, filters live in
the URL so Back works, logged-in details pre-fill
checkout and saved cards are remembered.

pages straight to the right answer and this
